rationale: The original entry thesis relied on price holding above the 5-minute 9-EMA and printing higher lows, both of which have failed as price broke below the 9-EMA ($334.47) to $333.67. The last four 1-minute candles show consecutive lower highs and lower lows with expanding sell volume on the breakdown. Given the wide 7.2 bps spread ($333.67 x $333.91) and proximity to the $333.50 hard stop, closing now allows the execution algorithm to attempt capturing passive liquidity near the ask rather than crossing the wide spread on a market stop-out.
